query:
update announcements set title = $2, body = $3, level = $4, display = $5,
                  cta_label = $6, cta_url = $7, starts_at = $8, ends_at = $9,
                  published_at = coalesce(published_at, case when $10 then now() end),
                  updated_at = now()
           where id = $1 and archived_at is null
